integrity.composition_basis: For consecutive matrix units, the composition is nonzero exactly when the source index of the second equals the target index of the first.
integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions, and projectivity converts it to ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1111.5514 lists its first submission on 2011-11-23.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A generic diagonal cocharacter has matrix-unit coordinate points as the only fixed points in every projective Hom factor.
integrity.object_basis: The archival full text explicitly defines the multiprojective variety of complexes inside a product of projective Hom spaces.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival article lists MSC 14M99 first, followed by 14N99 and 37F75; the work is explicitly on algebraic varieties of complexes.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes only ordinary Euler characteristic, not Betti numbers, intersection cohomology, irreducible components, multidegrees, or singularity structure.
It treats the full multiprojective complex variety with only consecutive-composition equations; extra rank conditions require a different count.
The localization argument is short, so an older unindexed or folklore observation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of the multiprojective variety of complexes
